text: DRUG INTERACTIONS NO PHARMACOKINETIC DRUG-DRUG INTERACTION STUDIES WERE CONDUCTED WITH DIPYRIDAMOLE TABLETS. THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION WAS OBTAINED FROM THE LITERATURE. ADENOSINERGIC AGENTS (E.G., ADENOSINE, REGADENOSON) DIPYRIDAMOLE HAS BEEN REPORTED TO INCREASE THE PLASMA LEVELS AND CARDIOVASCULAR EFFECTS OF ADENOSINE. ADJUSTMENT OF ADENOSINE DOSAGE MAY BE NECESSARY. DIPYRIDAMOLE ALSO INCREASES THE CARDIOVASCULAR EFFECTS OF REGADENOSON, AN ADENOSINE A 2A -RECEPTOR AGONIST. THE POTENTIAL RISK OF CARDIOVASCULAR SIDE EFFECTS WITH INTRAVENOUS ADENOSINERGIC AGENTS MAY BE INCREASED DURING THE TESTING PERIOD WHEN DIPYRIDAMOLE IS NOT HELD 48 HOURS PRIOR TO STRESS TESTING. CHOLINESTERASE INHIBITORS DIPYRIDAMOLE MAY COUNTERACT THE ANTICHOLINESTERASE EFFECT OF CHOLINESTERASE INHIBITORS, THEREBY POTENTIALLY AGGRAVATING MYASTHENIA GRAVIS. CONTRAINDICATIONS HYPERSENSITIVITY TO DIPYRIDAMOLE AND ANY OF THE OTHER COMPONENTS.
